message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. At the top, black text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2018". Below, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters, followed by "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below this, magenta text in a large sans-serif font reads "DIGITAL SAMPAI MATI". Smaller gray text follows: "MENGGERUS BISNIS KONVENSIONAL, EKONOMI BERBASIS JARINGAN AKAN TUMBUH SUBUR PADA 2018. PELUANG ATAU ANCAMAN?".

The central graphic features a large, pixelated black-and-white QR code. Small figures of people, colored entirely magenta, interact with the code. Some figures climb the code’s blocks, while others carry black square blocks or rectangular boxes towards it. In the lower-left, a crowd of magenta figures stands near a light pink truck. Several carry black rectangular objects. In the lower-right, black text states "27 NOVEMBER-3 DESEMBER 2017", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A barcode with the number "9 770126 427302" and "00040" is at the bottom right. A thick red band borders the left side.
